mapper.update: UPDATE user_membership SET level_code = CASE WHEN fallback_level_code = 1 THEN fallback_level_code ELSE level_code END, start_at = CASE WHEN fallback_level_code = 1 THEN COALESCE(fallback_start_at, start_at) ELSE start_at END, expire_at = CASE WHEN fallback_level_code = 1 THEN NULL ELSE expire_at END, status = CASE WHEN fallback_level_code = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, fallback_level_code = NULL, fallback_start_at = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND level_code = 2 AND status = 1 AND expire_at IS NOT NULL AND expire_at <= #{now}
